note: A synthetic client (Slice 129 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: We are an importer paying overseas suppliers about $6,000,000 a year by international wire. Fees and currency spreads cost us about 2.5% of that. A stablecoin payment provider says it can do the same for a total cost of 0.8%.

answers.common.decision: Whether to pilot stablecoin payments to suppliers; the finance director decides.
answers.common.audience: The finance director and our treasury team.
answers.common.materials: Only 4 of our 25 suppliers have said they would accept stablecoins. Those suppliers receive $1,500,000 of our payments a year.
answers.consulting.current-state: We have not used digital assets before. All supplier payments go by international wire through our bank.
answers.consulting.success: Lower payment costs without adding risks our bank or auditors object to.
answers.consulting.constraints: Treasury is two people; our bank must agree to any new payment route; we will not hold digital assets on our balance sheet.
